title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA AIRPORTS CORPORATION ACT

ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA AIRPORTS CORPORATION ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korea Airports Corporation Act and matters necessary for its enforcement. <Amended on Feb. 12, 2007>

Article 2 (Value of Capital Contributions of Airport Facility Management Rights)
The value of airport facility management rights contributed by the State or a local government to Korea Airports Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the “Corporation”) pursuant to Article 4 (3) of the Korea Airports Corporation Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall be determined on the basis of market value in accordance with statutes governing State property. <Amended on Feb. 12, 2007; Jul. 27, 2009>

Article 3 (Registration of Establishment)
The matters to be registered upon establishment of the Corporation pursuant to Article 5 (2) of the Act shall be as follows:
1. Its purpose;
2. Its name;
3. The location of its principal office or branch offices;
4. Its capital;
5. The names, resident registration numbers and addresses of its executive officers;
6. The method of public notice.

Article 4 (Registration of Establishment of Branch Offices)
Where the Corporation establishes a branch office, it shall register the name, location and date of establishment of the branch office at the location of its principal office within two weeks after establishment.

Article 5 (Registration of Relocation)
(1) Where the Corporation relocates its principal office, it shall register the new location and date of relocation at the former or new location within two weeks after relocation.
(2) Where the Corporation relocates a branch office, it shall register the new location and date of relocation at the location of its principal office within two weeks after relocation.

Article 6 (Registration of Changes)
Where a matter registered under any subparagraph of Article 3 or under Article 4 changes (excluding cases constituting registration of relocation under Article 5), the Corporation shall register the change at the location of its principal office within three weeks after the change.

Article 7 (Registration of Appointment of Agents, etc.)
(1) Where the president appoints an agent pursuant to Article 7 of the Act, the Corporation shall register the following matters at the location of its principal office within two weeks after appointment. The same shall apply where a registered matter changes. <Amended on Jan. 21, 2025>
1. The name, resident registration number and address of the agent;
2. Where the agent’s authority is restricted, the details of the restriction;
3. The name and location of the principal office or branch office at which the agent is placed.
(2) Where the president dismisses an agent appointed pursuant to Article 7 of the Act, the Corporation shall register that dismissal at the location of its principal office within two weeks after dismissal. <Amended on Jan. 21, 2025>

Article 8 (Documents Accompanying Applications for Registration)
An application for each registration under Articles 3 through 7 shall be accompanied by the following documents:
1. For registration of establishment of the Corporation under Article 3: The Corporation’s articles of incorporation and documents proving the amount of paid-in capital and the qualifications of its executive officers;
2. For registration of establishment of a branch office under Article 4: Documents proving the establishment of the branch office;
3. For registration of relocation under Article 5: Documents proving the relocation of the principal office or branch office;
4. For registration of a change under Article 6: Documents proving the changed matters;
5. For registration of the appointment, change or dismissal of an agent under Article 7: Documents proving that the appointment, change or dismissal is pursuant to Article 7 of the Act and, where the agent’s authority is restricted pursuant to Article 7 (1) 2, documents proving the restriction.

Article 9 (Business Activities)
(1) “Projects prescribed by Presidential Decree” in Article 9 (1) 3 of the Act means projects for the new construction, expansion or improvement of facilities falling under any of the following subparagraphs: <Amended on Nov. 21, 2014; Mar. 29, 2017>
1. Facilities under subparagraph 1 of Article 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Airport Facilities Act that fall under either of the following items:
(a) Facilities at airports managed and operated by the Corporation;
(b) Facilities at newly constructed airports designated by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport following deliberation by the Aviation Policy Committee under Article 4 of the Aviation Business Act;
2. Facilities under subparagraph 2 (a) through (k) of Article 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Airport Facilities Act (in the case of item (b), limited to flight operations management facilities, education and training facilities, and firefighting facilities).
(2) “Business activities meeting detailed standards prescribed by Presidential Decree, such as target areas and scope” in Article 9 (1) 3-2 of the Act means business activities meeting all the following standards: <Added on Nov. 21, 2014; Mar. 29, 2017>
1. Target area: An airport other than an airport that has obtained a Class I airport operating certificate under Article 42 (3) 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Airport Facilities Act, which falls under any of the following items:
(a) An airport at which education and training for the development of aviation personnel and the establishment and operation of training facilities necessary therefor under Article 9 (1) 1-2 of the Act are carried out;
(b) An airport at which aircraft used for small aircraft transport services under subparagraph 13 of Article 2 of the Aviation Business Act operate;
(c) An airport at which aircraft used for educational purposes by specialized educational institutions for aviation personnel under Article 48 of the Aviation Safety Act operate;
(d) An airport at which the average runway utilization rate (meaning the ratio of the total number of aircraft movements that actually used the runway in the relevant year to the total number of aircraft movements that the airport’s runway can accommodate in one year) and the average passenger terminal utilization rate (meaning the ratio of the total number of passengers who actually used the terminal in the relevant year to the total number of passengers that the airport’s passenger terminal can accommodate in one year) over the most recent three years are each below 50 percent;
(e) Any other airport at which the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport recognizes that the Corporation’s participation in business activities is necessary;
2. Scope: Business activities falling under either of the following items:
(a) Aircraft handling services under subparagraph 19 of Article 2 of the Aviation Business Act;
(b) Aircraft maintenance services under subparagraph 17 of Article 2 of the Aviation Business Act (limited to routine and simple maintenance duties specified and publicly notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, such as inspections and replenishment of lubricating oil that do not require special equipment or facilities);
3. Participation by business operators other than the Corporation shall be limited or difficult, and the Corporation’s participation shall be unavoidable to ensure the safe operation of aircraft, revitalize regional airports, improve user convenience, promote the development of the aviation industry, etc.
(3) “Business activities prescribed by Presidential Decree” in Article 9 (1) 7 of the Act means any of the following business activities: <Amended on Nov. 21, 2014; Mar. 29, 2017>
1. Education and training for personnel associated with airport facilities under Article 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Airport Facilities Act (hereinafter referred to as “airport facilities”);
2. Technical support related to the management and operation of airport facilities;
3. Other business activities incidental to carrying out business activities under subparagraphs 1 through 5 of Article 9 of the Act.
(4) Detailed standards concerning target areas, scope, etc. under the subparagraphs of paragraph (2) shall be prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport following deliberation by the Aviation Policy Committee under Article 4 of the Aviation Business Act. <Added on Nov. 21, 2014; Mar. 29, 2017>

Article 10 Deleted. <Jun. 29, 2012>

Article 11 Deleted. <Jun. 29, 2012>

Article 12 Deleted. <Jun. 29, 2012>

Article 13 Deleted. <Jun. 13, 2017>

(11) The Organization of the Ministry of Construction and Transportation and Its Affiliated Agencies is amended as follows:

(12) The Enforcement Decree of the Tourism Promotion and Development Fund Act is amended as follows:

(13) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Special Measures for Designation and Management of Development Restriction Zones is amended as follows:
In Article 35 (1) 1 (a), “Korea Airports Authority under the Korea Airports Authority Act” is replaced by “Korea Airports Corporation under the Korea Airports Corporation Act.”

Article 4 (Relationship with Other Statutes)
Where another statute cites the Enforcement Decree of the Korea Airports Authority Act or any provision thereof as at the time this Decree enters into force, and a corresponding provision exists in this Decree, that citation shall be deemed to be a citation of the Enforcement Decree of the Korea Airports Corporation Act or the corresponding provision of this Decree.
